jobs.description:
Support the Director of Market Access to develop and execute market access strategies that enable optimal launch, pricing, reimbursement, and sustainable access to a specialty care indications across international markets and designated partner regions. The role requires strategic thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and solid knowledge of international market access policies, health economics, and stakeholder engagement to deliver timely and equitable patient access.
 Main responsibilities

• Planning: Support development and implementation of comprehensive market access strategies tailored to launching Specialty care product, diverse international markets and partner regions, aligned with corporate objectives, regulatory landscapes, and local affiliate needs.

• Pricing and reimbursement: Collaborate to secure pricing, reimbursement, and formulary inclusion for new and existing products, leveraging health economic models, budget impact analyses, and value-based arguments.

• Evidence and value communication: Support the development of HEOR evidence, real-world data (RWD), and global/local value dossiers to inform HTA submissions and payer negotiations; contribute to objection handlers and payer negotiation materials.

• Stakeholder engagement: Build and maintain compliant relationships with external stakeholders (payers, HTA agencies, partners, regulatory bodies, and patient advocacy groups) to facilitate access, inform strategy, and shape evidence needs.

• Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with global and local Medical, Commercial, Regulatory, Legal, and Government Affairs teams to synchronize market access initiatives, share best practices, and ensure launch readiness.

• Policy monitoring and advocacy: Monitor policy developments and trends across international and partner regions; proactively identify risks and opportunities and support advocacy efforts that enhance patient access.

• Project leadership and operations: Manage multiple concurrent market access projects, ensuring timely delivery, budget adherence, risk management, and measurable outcomes; oversee vendor activities where relevant.

• Reporting and metrics: Track, analyse, and report on access performance, milestones (e.g., HTA outcomes, P&R decisions), and competitive intelligence across assigned regions; maintain accurate, timely updates in PRISMA, Smartsheet, and other internal systems.

• Education: Advanced degree in life sciences, pharmacy, public health, economics, or related field (PhD, MSc, MBA preferred).

• 7+ years in market access and reimbursement within international region role, focusing on GI, internal medicine, endocrinology, Cardiovascular and rare disease market access, with strong understanding for both niche and large patient populations reimbursement.

• Proven track record in international launch planning and execution, including access strategy development with payers and policy makers networks for both niche and large populations markets.

• Effective track record working in matrixed, multicultural teams across different regions.

• Good understanding of international healthcare systems, HTA processes, and both public and private payers’ environment.

• Fluent English; additional languages desirable.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

Sostenere il Direttore dell'accesso ai mercati per sviluppare ed attuare strategie di accesso ai mercati che consentano il lancio ottimale, la fissazione dei prezzi, il rimborso e l'accesso sostenibile a un'indicazione di assistenza specialistica in tutti i mercati internazionali e nelle regioni partner designate. Il ruolo richiede un pensiero strategico, una collaborazione interfunzionale e una solida conoscenza delle politiche internazionali di accesso ai mercati, dell'economia sanitaria e dell'impegno degli stakeholder per garantire un accesso tempestivo ed equo ai pazienti.

Responsabilità

- Pianificazione: sostenere lo sviluppo e l'attuazione di strategie globali di accesso al mercato su misura per lanciare prodotti per la cura delle specialità, diversi mercati internazionali e regioni partner, in linea con gli obiettivi aziendali, i paesaggi normativi e le esigenze di affiliazione locale. - Prezzi e rimborsi: il 21a per garantire prezzi, rimborsi e inclusione di formule per i prodotti nuovi e esistenti, sfruttando modelli economici per la salute, analisi di impatto sul bilancio e argomenti basati sul valore.

- Evidence and value communication: Support the development of HEOR evidence, real-world data (RWD) and global/local value dossiers to information HTA submissions and payer conference negoziation; contribuire a gestire le obiezioni e a negoziare i materiali per i contribuenti. - Impegno delle parti interessate: creare e mantenere relazioni conformi con le parti interessate esterne (pagatori, agenzie HTA, partner, organismi di regolamentazione e gruppi di advocacy dei pazienti) per facilitare l'accesso, informare la strategia e definire le esigenze di prove.

- Collaborazione interfunzionale: partner con i team di Medical, Commerciale, Regolativa, Legale e Governativa a livello globale e locale per sincronizzare le iniziative di accesso al mercato, condividere le migliori pratiche e garantire la disponibilità al lancio. - Monitoraggio delle politiche e della difesa: monitorare gli sviluppi e le tendenze delle politiche in regioni internazionali e partner; identificare proattivamente rischi e opportunità e sostenere gli sforzi di difesa che migliorano l'accesso dei pazienti.

- Direzione e operazioni del progetto: gestire più progetti di accesso concorrente al mercato, garantire la consegna tempestiva, l'aderenza al bilancio, la gestione dei rischi e gli esiti misurabili; sorvegliare le attività dei fornitori, se del caso. - Relazioni e metriche: monitorare, analizzare e riferire sulle prestazioni di accesso, le tappe fondamentali (ad esempio, risultati HTA, decisioni P&R) e l'intelligenza competitiva in tutte le regioni assegnate; mantenere aggiornati precisi e tempestivi in PRISMA, Smartsheet e altri sistemi interni.

Requisiti

- Istruzione: laurea in scienze della vita, farmacia, sanità pubblica, economia o campo correlato (PhD, MSc, MBA preferito). - 7 anni più in accesso al mercato e rimborso all'interno del ruolo della regione internazionale, concentrandosi su GI, medicina interna, endocrinologia, accesso al mercato delle malattie cardiovascolari e rare, con una forte comprensione sia per il rimborso di nicchia e grandi popolazioni di pazienti. - Proven record nella pianificazione e attuazione di lancio internazionale, compreso lo sviluppo di strategie di accesso con i contribuenti e reti di responsabili politici per i mercati di nicchia e grandi popolazioni.

- Buona comprensione dei sistemi sanitari internazionali, dei processi HTA e dei contribuenti pubblici e privati. ambiente. - Inglese fluente; lingue supplementari desiderabili.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Warenbezeichnung

Unterstützung des Direktors des Marktzugangs bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Marktzugangsstrategien, die eine optimale Einführung, Preisgestaltung, Erstattung und einen nachhaltigen Zugang zu speziellen Pflegehinweisen in internationalen Märkten und bestimmten Partnerregionen ermöglichen. Die Rolle erfordert strategisches Denken, funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit und solide Kenntnisse über internationale Marktzugangspolitiken, Gesundheitsökonomie und Stakeholder-Verpflichtung, um einen zeitnahen und gerechten Patientenzugang zu gewährleisten.

Zuständigkeiten

- Planung: Unterstützung der Entwicklung und Umsetzung umfassender Marktzugangsstrategien, die auf die Einführung von Spezialpflegeprodukten, verschiedenen internationalen Märkten und Partnerregionen zugeschnitten sind, die mit den Zielen der Unternehmen, regulatorischen Landschaften und lokalen Affiliate-Anforderungen abgestimmt sind. - Preisgestaltung und Erstattung: Zusammenarbeit zur Sicherstellung der Preisbildung, der Erstattung und der Integration neuer und bestehender Produkte, Nutzung gesundheitsökonomischer Modelle, Budget-Wirkungsanalysen und wertbasierter Argumente.

- Evidenz- und Wertkommunikation: Unterstützung der Entwicklung von HEOR-Evidenz-, Real-World-Daten (RWD) und Global/Local Value-Dossiers zur Information von HTA-Einreichungen und Payer-Verhandlungen; Beitrag zu Einwänden gegen Handler und Payer-Verhandlungsmaterialien. - Stakeholder-Engagement: Aufbau und Pflege konformer Beziehungen mit externen Stakeholdern (Zahler, HTA-Agenturen, Partner, Regulierungsstellen und Patienten-Advocacy-Gruppen) zur Erleichterung des Zugangs, der Informationsstrategie und der Gestaltung von Evidenzbedürfnissen.

- Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Partner mit globalen und lokalen Teams für Medizin, Handel, Regulierung, Recht und Regierung, um Marktzugangsinitiativen zu synchronisieren, bewährte Verfahren zu teilen und die Startbereitschaft zu gewährleisten. - Politiküberwachung und -verfechtung: Überwachung der politischen Entwicklungen und Trends in internationalen und Partnerregionen; proaktive Identifizierung von Risiken und Chancen und Unterstützung von Advocacy-Bemühungen, die den Zugang zu Patienten verbessern.

- Projektleitung und Betrieb: Verwaltung mehrerer paralleler Marktzugangsprojekte, Gewährleistung einer rechtzeitigen Bereitstellung, Budgetbindung, Risikomanagement und messbare Ergebnisse; Überwachung der Lieferantenaktivitäten, soweit relevant. - Berichterstattung und Metriken: Verfolgung, Analyse und Bericht über die Zugangsleistung, Meilensteine (z.B. HTA-Ergebnisse, P&R-Entscheidungen) und wettbewerbsfähige Intelligenz in zugewiesenen Regionen; Aufrechterhaltung genauer, zeitnaher Updates in PRISMA, Smartsheet und anderen internen Systemen.

Anforderungen

- Ausbildung: Studium der Biowissenschaften, Pharmazie, öffentliche Gesundheit, Wirtschaft oder verwandten Bereichen (PhD, MSc, MBA bevorzugt). - 7+ Jahre Marktzugang und Erstattung innerhalb der internationalen Region Rolle, mit Schwerpunkt auf GI, Innere Medizin, Endokrinologie, Kardiovaskuläre und seltene Krankheiten Marktzugang, mit einem starken Verständnis für Nischen-und große Patientenpopulationen Erstattung. - Bewährte Erfolgsbilanz in der internationalen Startplanung und -ausführung, einschließlich Zugang Strategieentwicklung mit Zahlern und politischen Entscheidungsträgern Netzwerke für Nischen-und großen Bevölkerungsmärkten.

- Effektive Erfolgsbilanz in matrixierten, multikulturellen Teams in verschiedenen Regionen. - Gutes Verständnis für internationale Gesundheitssysteme, HTA-Prozesse, und sowohl öffentliche als auch private Zahler, Umwelt. - Fließendes Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen wünschenswert.

Ansprechpartner

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Désignation des marchandises

Appuyer le directeur de l'accès aux marchés afin d'élaborer et d'exécuter des stratégies d'accès aux marchés qui permettent un lancement optimal, des prix, des remboursements et un accès durable à des indications sur les soins spécialisés dans les marchés internationaux et les régions partenaires désignées.

Responsabilités

- Planification : Appuyer l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre de stratégies globales d'accès aux marchés adaptées au lancement de produits de soins spécialisés, de marchés internationaux diversifiés et de régions partenaires, en harmonie avec les objectifs de l'entreprise, les paysages réglementaires et les besoins locaux des filiales. - Prix et remboursement : Collaborer pour obtenir des prix, des remboursements et une inclusion de formules pour les produits nouveaux et existants, en tirant parti des modèles économiques de la santé, des analyses d'impact budgétaire et des arguments fondés sur la valeur.

- Communication de données et de valeurs : Appuyer l'élaboration de données de la HEOR, de données du monde réel et de dossiers de valeurs mondiales/locales pour informer les présentations de HTA et de négociations de l'année; contribuer aux gestionnaires des objections et de documents de négociation de l'année; - Engagement des parties prenantes : Établir et maintenir des relations conformes avec les parties prenantes externes (payeurs, organismes de HTA, partenaires, organismes de réglementation et groupes de défense des patients) afin de faciliter l'accès, d'informer la stratégie et de façonner les besoins en matière de données probantes.

- Collaboration interfonctionnelle : partenariat avec les équipes mondiales et locales des affaires médicales, commerciales, réglementaires, juridiques et gouvernementales pour synchroniser les initiatives d'accès aux marchés, partager les meilleures pratiques et assurer la préparation au lancement. - Suivi et plaidoyer des politiques : suivre l'évolution et les tendances des politiques dans les régions internationales et partenaires; identifier de façon proactive les risques et les possibilités et appuyer les efforts de plaidoyer qui améliorent l'accès des patients.

- Diriger et gérer les projets : gérer plusieurs projets d'accès simultanés aux marchés, assurer la prestation en temps opportun, l'observation du budget, la gestion des risques et des résultats mesurables; superviser les activités des fournisseurs, le cas échéant. - Rapports et mesures : suivre, analyser et rendre compte du rendement de l'accès, des étapes (p. ex., les résultats de l'AHV, les décisions de R et R) et de l'information concurrentielle dans les régions désignées; tenir à jour en temps opportun et de façon précise les données de la PRISMA, de la feuille d'information intelligente et d'autres systèmes internes.

Besoins

- Formation : Diplôme de niveau supérieur en sciences de la vie, pharmacie, santé publique, économie ou domaine connexe (PhD, MSc, MBA préféré). - 7 ans et plus en accès aux marchés et remboursement dans la région internationale, en mettant l'accent sur l'IG, la médecine interne, l'endocrinologie, l'accès aux marchés des maladies cardiovasculaires et rares, avec une bonne compréhension pour le remboursement des patients niches et des grands patients. - Preuve de la qualité de la planification et de l'exécution des lancements internationaux, y compris l'élaboration de stratégies d'accès avec les pays du bassin des pays du bassin des pays du bassin des pays du bassin des pays du bassin des Caraïbes et des pays du bassin des Caraïbes.

- Bonne compréhension des systèmes de santé internationaux, des processus de la HTA et de l'environnement public et privé. - Anglais fluide; langues supplémentaires souhaitables.

jobs.description:
Introduction/Purpose:
 The position holder will be office based and is expected to travel occasionally for internal and external meetings, trainings and conferences. It will be the responsibility of the position holder to help develop the presence and recognition of Sobi as a credible partner within the rare disease community through supporting the development of relationships with key stakeholders (especially physicians), as well as authorities and patient access colleagues as well as DACH and HQ staff in a cross functional approach to Sobi’s interactions with all stakeholders (physicians, payers, nurses and patients).
 Objective for the company:
 Propose and implement market access strategies and tactics for all Sobi products that are already launched and marketed in the DACH region in light of the current applicable regulations and the expectations of the health authorities, customers and patients organizations.
 Key Responsibilities:

• Work closely with the local cross-functional product teams as well as with the National Sales Managers to identify pricing and positioning opportunities as well as threats for the Haemophilia franchise, Haematology and Immunology products.

• Strong collaboration with finance, sales and patient access to manage existing and develop new pricing and reimbursement offers and the impact from an economical perspective

• Monitor competitive environment and develop appropriate pricing and contracting strategies for marketed Sobi products to support commercial business goals

• Execute and negotiate pricing and contracting strategies with relevant stakeholders as sick funds or physician associations where needed

• Produce and analyse contract/payer specific reports

• Develop consultative relationships with key decision makers and stakeholders and leverage Sobi as the preferred partner for innovative contracting models

• Identify national and regional authorities and stakeholders with responsibility for the pricing and reimbursement of existing and new products and engage appropriately with such bodies together with the Director Patient Access & Engagement DACH to understand requirements and support for optimal pricing and reimbursement

• Proactively track key legislative changes and sick fund related changes with potential impact on Sobi’s business

• Develop and drive local real-world evidence and HEOR strategy as well as respective publication plan to demonstrate reliable insights of health care reality and benefits of modern therapy approaches

• Liase with Marketing and Patient Access to drive materials, fact sheets, cost calculators and other selling tools

• Support the AMNOG process for Sobi’s pre-launch products by shaping reimbursement strategies, dossiers and benefit assessment process in close collaboration with the pre-launch Patient Access team

• Propose, coordinate and lead AMNOG negotiations with GKV-SV in close collaboration with the pre-launch Patient Access team

Education

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Healthcare, Economics, Public Health, or a related field

• Recent graduates are welcome to apply
 Experience

• Internship or academic experience in market access, health economics, pricing & reimbursement, or healthcare policy is an advantage but not required

All Sobi employees need to demonstrate behaviors in line with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership. Are you ready to be on the Sobi team? Come join a culture that empowers every person to be the person that makes a difference for rare disease.
 Why Join Us?

We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases, and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

jobs.description:
The PV Partnership & Operations Director provides strategic leadership, accountability and effectiveness of the Sobi PV Partnership & Operations function, ensuring productive collaboration between Sobi PV Operations, internal stakeholders (including clinical development functions and clinical development teams), co-development, co-promotion and distributor partners, and external service providers (GPV and clinical development vendors).
 Under the overall lead of the Head of Global PV Operations, the PV Partnership & Operations Director works together with the PV Vendor Management Director and the PV Licensing Director to ensure the overall delivery of the Sobi PV Operations function. The focus of the PV Partnerships and Operations being towards the “customers” of GPV and the ongoing maintenance and compliance of activities associated with these partners. The role is accountable for partner-related PV operations activities, including the operationalisation and ongoing compliance with pharmacovigilance agreements, ensuring PVA commitments are adhered to from both Sobi and partners sides, and oversight of case exchange and reconciliation activities. The role is generally more focused towards product level engagements – in terms of product level Partner engagements, and product and study level development and clinical trial activities. The role works closely with PV Licensing for the set up and implementation of PVAs, and with PV VM to direct the delivery of Sobi PV vendors.
 Together with GPV Safety Science and appropriate Sobi RDMA functions, this role has a strategic leadership to drive best practices for clinical trial operations, clinical trial systems and clinical trial vendor management. This includes PV delivery that is both GVP and GCP inspection ready and compliant
 The Director leads and develops the PV Partnership & Operations team. This global team of “product aligned” PV Partnership Managers are responsible for the product level deliverables. The team members are located in several countries.
 Key Responsibilities:
 Functional leadership and team management

• Lead the PV Partnership & Operations function, assigning and coordinating activities across the team, setting strategic direction, priorities, operating model, governance structures and performance expectations.

• Provide overall accountability for the function’s activities, deliverables, quality, compliance, risk management, performance monitoring and inspection readiness. Highlighting areas of concern to GPV Management

• Lead, develop and oversee the PV Partnership & Operations team, including resource management, recruitment, performance management, capability building, coaching, escalation support and succession planning.
 Partnership governance and pharmacovigilance agreements

• Provide PV functional leadership for new and existing Sobi partner collaborations, including alliance leadership, operational activities, PV process alignment, governance meetings and escalation processes.

• Accountable for that partner and distributor obligations under PVAs and SDEAs are clearly defined, implemented and fulfilled.

• Accountable for case exchange elements in Pharmacovigilance Agreements and Safety Data Exchange Agreements (inc oversight and reconciliation). Identification of delivery gaps and development and delivery of appropriate corrective actions.

• Maintain oversight of case exchange quality, timeliness, completeness and reconciliation activities, ensuring discrepancies are investigated and resolved appropriately.

• Work with PV VM team, and through the VM Team if applicable with the Sobi PV eESPs, to understand concerns on performance and quality, and to develop and implement appropriate corrective actions.
 Clinical studies, marketed products and safety data management

• Work with the ODT Tech lead and OSIRIS Config team to ensure the appropriate configuration for products, clinical trials and marketing authorisations.

• Lead the development of, and overall accountability, for “study level” Safety Management Plans across Sobi functions and external service providers, ensuring clear roles and responsibilities and delivery and quality expectations for case management and safety reporting within clinical studies.

• Accountable for study training of case processing vendor

• Oversee collaboration with Clinical Operations, Global Regulatory Affairs, Contract Research Organisations, Clinical Data Management and other stakeholders to ensure appropriate transfer, reconciliation and reporting of safety data.

• Accountable for preparation, approval and maintenance of “product level” case-processing Product Safety Information guides and appropriate assessment of Market Research and Patient Support Program materials for PV impact.
 Quality, compliance, audits and inspections

• Work closely with GPV Excellence, Sobi QA, PV VM, other Sobi function and external vendors to we ensure quality and compliance standards and defined and maintained for PV activities with “partners”.

• Ensure quality and compliance of PV Partnership & Operations activities, including proactive identification and management of operational, quality and compliance risks.

• Work with Safety Science Leads to ensure individual case safety data are of appropriate quality to support aggregate reporting and signal management activities and ensure feedback, with appropriate corrective measures, to case processing vendor

• Act as the senior subject matter expert for audits and inspections relating to PV Partnership & Operations activities

• Oversee non-conformance investigations, corrective and preventive actions, issue escalation, inspection readiness, and preparation, coordination and follow-up of relevant audits and regulatory inspections.
 PV systems, databases and cross-functional collaboration

• Responsible for ensuring that new and/or changed PV partnerships, study or product activities that impact the Sobi PV system and Sobi PV Vendor operations are appropriately flagged and addressed by the responsible teams (inc Sobi PV VM, Osiris Configuration team). Together with responsible functions, ensuring systems are set up and functioning appropriately to meet Sobi GPV PV commitments.

• Leadership of the PV Partnership team contribution to company acquisitions, product integrations and other business development activities with impact on the Sobi PV system. Including contribution to the future PV operating model, clear alignment of roles and responsibilities between Sobi PV and a partner, design and delivery of a PV data migration and integration of products and activities into the Sobi PV system. PV system configuration and operational readiness across products,

• Oversight of the respective PV Partnership Manager in the design, set up, operations and close out of the PV system to support Sobi sponsored clinical studies and ISSs

• Accountable for the Drug Safety inbox and to ensure oversight and continued coverage by the team.

• Serve as the senior functional interface between PV Operations, Safety Science and relevant Sobi business functions on product-specific and process-related matters (e.g. case processing questions).

Education/Learning Experience/Work Experience
 Required:

• University level qualification in biosciences, healthcare or pharmacy.

• At least 10 years of relevant pharmacovigilance experience within the pharmaceutical industry, including strong experience in case processing, clinical study safety data management, partner/vendor oversight and applicable GVP, GCP and global regulatory requirements.

• Experience leading and developing teams, including effective people management, supervision, capability building and prioritisation of work in a complex operational environment.

• Strong organisational, planning, prioritisation and problem-solving skills.
 Desired:

• Working knowledge of IQVIA Vigilance Platform.

• Previous international / global people management experience.
 Skills/Knowledge/Languages

• Thorough knowledge of GVP and GCP.

• Fluent English, written and spoken.
 Personal Attributes

• Ability to work effectively to deliver ambitious goals.

• Effective team leadership, team development and management. Able to prepare, empower and support assigned team to cover the broad range of deliverables this team is responsible for.

• Ability to work collaboratively in internal and external cross-functional settings and matrix teams.

• Proactive, independent and collaborative problem-solver with the judgement, determination and courage to resolve or escalate issues as appropriate. Able to drive collaborative assessment and solution development and effective implementation to complex and cross functional and cross company problems encounters

• Strong relationship builder and collaborator within PV and across the wider organisation.

• Clear communicator, able to distill down large amounts of information to root cause and propose appropriate actions.

• Sound and balanced judgement; able to assess and manage risks; self-confident, proactive and decisive.

Compensation and Total Rewards at Sobi
 At Sobi, we are dedicated to providing our employees with a comprehensive and industry-competitive total rewards package. Our compensation philosophy is designed to recognize and reward talent, ensuring that your contributions are valued and reflected in your overall rewards.
 All Sobi employees need to demonstrate behaviors in line with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership. Are you ready to be on the Sobi team? Come join a culture that empowers every person to be the person that makes a difference for rare disease.
 Why Join Us?

We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases, and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

The PV Partnership & Operations Director provides strategic leadership, accountability and effectiveness of the Sobi PV Partnership & Operations function, ensuring productive collaboration between Sobi PV Operations, internal stakeholders (including clinical development functions and clinical development teams), co-development, co-promotion and distributor partners, and external service providers (GPV and clinical development vendors).
Under the overall lead of the Head of Global PV Operations, the PV Partnership & Operations Director works together with the PV Vendor Management Director and the PV Licensing Director to ensure the overall delivery of the Sobi PV Operations function. The focus of the PV Partnerships and Operations being towards the “customers” of GPV and the ongoing maintenance and compliance of activities associated with these partners. The role is accountable for partner-related PV operations activities, including the operationalisation and ongoing compliance with pharmacovigilance agreements, ensuring PVA commitments are adhered to from both Sobi and partners sides, and oversight of case exchange and reconciliation activities. The role is generally more focused towards product level engagements – in terms of product level Partner engagements, and product and study level development and clinical trial activities. The role works closely with PV Licensing for the set up and implementation of PVAs, and with PV VM to direct the delivery of Sobi PV vendors.
Together with GPV Safety Science and appropriate Sobi RDMA functions, this role has a strategic leadership to drive best practices for clinical trial operations, clinical trial systems and clinical trial vendor management. This includes PV delivery that is both GVP and GCP inspection ready and compliant
The Director leads and develops the PV Partnership & Operations team. This global team of “product aligned” PV Partnership Managers are responsible for the product level deliverables. The team members are located in several countries.
Key Responsibilities:
Functional leadership and team management

• Lead the PV Partnership & Operations function, assigning and coordinating activities across the team, setting strategic direction, priorities, operating model, governance structures and performance expectations.

• Provide overall accountability for the function’s activities, deliverables, quality, compliance, risk management, performance monitoring and inspection readiness. Highlighting areas of concern to GPV Management

• Lead, develop and oversee the PV Partnership & Operations team, including resource management, recruitment, performance management, capability building, coaching, escalation support and succession planning.
Partnership governance and pharmacovigilance agreements

• Provide PV functional leadership for new and existing Sobi partner collaborations, including alliance leadership, operational activities, PV process alignment, governance meetings and escalation processes.

• Accountable for that partner and distributor obligations under PVAs and SDEAs are clearly defined, implemented and fulfilled.

• Accountable for case exchange elements in Pharmacovigilance Agreements and Safety Data Exchange Agreements (inc oversight and reconciliation). Identification of delivery gaps and development and delivery of appropriate corrective actions.

• Maintain oversight of case exchange quality, timeliness, completeness and reconciliation activities, ensuring discrepancies are investigated and resolved appropriately.

• Work with PV VM team, and through the VM Team if applicable with the Sobi PV eESPs, to understand concerns on performance and quality, and to develop and implement appropriate corrective actions.
Clinical studies, marketed products and safety data management

• Work with the ODT Tech lead and OSIRIS Config team to ensure the appropriate configuration for products, clinical trials and marketing authorisations.

• Lead the development of, and overall accountability, for “study level” Safety Management Plans across Sobi functions and external service providers, ensuring clear roles and responsibilities and delivery and quality expectations for case management and safety reporting within clinical studies.

• Accountable for study training of case processing vendor

• Oversee collaboration with Clinical Operations, Global Regulatory Affairs, Contract Research Organisations, Clinical Data Management and other stakeholders to ensure appropriate transfer, reconciliation and reporting of safety data.

• Accountable for preparation, approval and maintenance of “product level” case-processing Product Safety Information guides and appropriate assessment of Market Research and Patient Support Program materials for PV impact.
Quality, compliance, audits and inspections

• Work closely with GPV Excellence, Sobi QA, PV VM, other Sobi function and external vendors to we ensure quality and compliance standards and defined and maintained for PV activities with “partners”.

• Ensure quality and compliance of PV Partnership & Operations activities, including proactive identification and management of operational, quality and compliance risks.

• Work with Safety Science Leads to ensure individual case safety data are of appropriate quality to support aggregate reporting and signal management activities and ensure feedback, with appropriate corrective measures, to case processing vendor

• Act as the senior subject matter expert for audits and inspections relating to PV Partnership & Operations activities

• Oversee non-conformance investigations, corrective and preventive actions, issue escalation, inspection readiness, and preparation, coordination and follow-up of relevant audits and regulatory inspections.
PV systems, databases and cross-functional collaboration

• Responsible for ensuring that new and/or changed PV partnerships, study or product activities that impact the Sobi PV system and Sobi PV Vendor operations are appropriately flagged and addressed by the responsible teams (inc Sobi PV VM, Osiris Configuration team). Together with responsible functions, ensuring systems are set up and functioning appropriately to meet Sobi GPV PV commitments.

• Leadership of the PV Partnership team contribution to company acquisitions, product integrations and other business development activities with impact on the Sobi PV system. Including contribution to the future PV operating model, clear alignment of roles and responsibilities between Sobi PV and a partner, design and delivery of a PV data migration and integration of products and activities into the Sobi PV system. PV system configuration and operational readiness across products,

• Oversight of the respective PV Partnership Manager in the design, set up, operations and close out of the PV system to support Sobi sponsored clinical studies and ISSs

• Accountable for the Drug Safety inbox and to ensure oversight and continued coverage by the team.

• Serve as the senior functional interface between PV Operations, Safety Science and relevant Sobi business functions on product-specific and process-related matters (e.g. case processing questions).

Education/Learning Experience/Work Experience
Required:

• University level qualification in biosciences, healthcare or pharmacy.

• At least 10 years of relevant pharmacovigilance experience within the pharmaceutical industry, including strong experience in case processing, clinical study safety data management, partner/vendor oversight and applicable GVP, GCP and global regulatory requirements.

• Experience leading and developing teams, including effective people management, supervision, capability building and prioritisation of work in a complex operational environment.

• Strong organisational, planning, prioritisation and problem-solving skills.
Desired:

• Working knowledge of IQVIA Vigilance Platform.

• Previous international / global people management experience.
Skills/Knowledge/Languages

• Thorough knowledge of GVP and GCP.

• Fluent English, written and spoken.
Personal Attributes

• Ability to work effectively to deliver ambitious goals.

• Effective team leadership, team development and management. Able to prepare, empower and support assigned team to cover the broad range of deliverables this team is responsible for.

• Ability to work collaboratively in internal and external cross-functional settings and matrix teams.

• Proactive, independent and collaborative problem-solver with the judgement, determination and courage to resolve or escalate issues as appropriate. Able to drive collaborative assessment and solution development and effective implementation to complex and cross functional and cross company problems encounters

• Strong relationship builder and collaborator within PV and across the wider organisation.

• Clear communicator, able to distill down large amounts of information to root cause and propose appropriate actions.

• Sound and balanced judgement; able to assess and manage risks; self-confident, proactive and decisive.

Compensation and Total Rewards at Sobi
At Sobi, we are dedicated to providing our employees with a comprehensive and industry-competitive total rewards package. Our compensation philosophy is designed to recognize and reward talent, ensuring that your contributions are valued and reflected in your overall rewards.
All Sobi employees need to demonstrate behaviors in line with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership. Are you ready to be on the Sobi team? Come join a culture that empowers every person to be the person that makes a difference for rare disease.
Why Join Us?

We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases, and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

Vergütung und Total Rewards bei Sobi

Alle Mitarbeiter von Sobi müssen Verhaltensweisen im Einklang mit den Grundwerten von Sobi demonstrieren: Pflege, Ehrgeiz, Dringlichkeit, Eigentum und Partnerschaft. Bist du bereit, im Sobi-Team zu sein? Kommen Sie zu einer Kultur, die jede Person befähigt, die Person zu sein, die einen Unterschied für seltene Krankheiten macht.
Warum mitmachen?

Wir sind ein globales Unternehmen mit über 1.900 Mitarbeitern in mehr als 30 Ländern und engagieren uns für die Gesellschaften, in denen wir tätig sind. Mit einem hochqualifizierten Managementteam, das unsere täglichen Siege leitet, und einem Vorstand mit einer hervorragenden Erfolgsbilanz sind wir bereit, uns den Krankheiten, Leiden und Widrigkeiten der Welt zu stellen. Unsere Leute glauben, dass sie die Macht haben, einen positiven Einfluss auf das Leben anderer zu haben, denn genau das tun wir hier. Wenn Sie eine Karriere suchen, die Ihre Talente auf eine Weise nutzt, die die Welt zu einem besseren und gesünderen Ort macht, haben wir vielleicht einen Job für Sie.

Wir wissen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter unser wertvollstes Kapital sind, und unsere Kultur vermittelt das. Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges Leistungspaket, um die Gesundheit und das Glück unserer Mitarbeiter zu unterstützen.

Sobikultur

Bei Sobi weigern wir uns, den Status quo zu akzeptieren. Dies liegt daran, dass wir die Herausforderungen für Menschen, die von seltenen Krankheiten betroffen sind, aus erster Hand miterlebt und dieses Wissen genutzt haben, um unser Geschäft zu gestalten, um neue Wege zu finden, ihnen zu helfen.

Als spezialisiertes biopharmazeutisches Unternehmen widmen wir uns seltenen Krankheiten. Und wir sehen diesen Fokus als Stärke. Indem wir unsere Forschung effektiv in bahnbrechende Behandlungen umwandeln, helfen wir, die Medizin zugänglicher zu machen und mehr Möglichkeiten für Patienten und mehr Möglichkeiten für diejenigen zu eröffnen, die sich um sie kümmern. Dies ist seit dem ersten Tag unser Ansatz, aber wir wissen, dass wir die Welt der seltenen Krankheiten nicht alleine verändern können. Um dies zu erreichen, sind starke Partnerschaften mit Patienten, Partnern und Stakeholdern entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette erforderlich. Gemeinsam definieren wir, wie unser Unternehmen Lösungen schaffen kann, die den Bedürfnissen der von seltenen Krankheiten Betroffenen gerecht werden und gleichzeitig nachhaltiges Wachstum ermöglichen.

Ce rôle travaille en étroite collaboration avec PV Licensing pour la mise en place et la mise en œuvre des PVA, et avec PV VM pour diriger la livraison des fournisseurs de Sobi PV.
En collaboration avec GPV Safety Science et les fonctions Sobi RDMA appropriées, ce rôle a un leadership stratégique pour diriger les meilleures pratiques pour les opérations d'essais cliniques, les systèmes d'essais cliniques et la gestion des fournisseurs d'essais cliniques. Cela comprend la livraison de VP qui est à la fois GVP et GCP inspection prête et conforme
Le directeur dirige et développe l'équipe Partenariat et opérations PV. Cette équipe mondiale de responsables de partenariat PV -produit aligné est responsable des produits livrables. Les membres de l'équipe sont situés dans plusieurs pays.
Principales responsabilités :
Leadership fonctionnel et gestion d'équipe

• Diriger la fonction Partenariat et opérations PV, assigner et coordonner les activités de l'équipe, établir l'orientation stratégique, les priorités, le modèle opérationnel, les structures de gouvernance et les attentes en matière de rendement.

• Assurer la responsabilité globale des activités, des produits livrables, de la qualité, de la conformité, de la gestion des risques, de la surveillance du rendement et de la préparation aux inspections. Mettre en évidence les domaines de préoccupation de la gestion du VPH

• Diriger, développer et superviser l'équipe du Partenariat et des Opérations du VP, y compris la gestion des ressources, le recrutement, la gestion du rendement, le renforcement des capacités, l'encadrement, le soutien à l'escalade et la planification de la relève.
Accords de gouvernance de partenariat et de pharmacovigilance

• Assurer le leadership fonctionnel du PV pour les collaborations nouvelles et existantes des partenaires Sobi, y compris le leadership de l'alliance, les activités opérationnelles, l'alignement des processus du PV, les réunions de gouvernance et les processus d'escalade.

• Les obligations de ce partenaire et de ce distributeur en vertu des APV et des ADD sont clairement définies, mises en œuvre et remplies.

• Responsable des éléments d'échange de cas dans les accords de pharmacovigilance et les accords d'échange de données de sécurité (y compris la surveillance et le rapprochement). Identification des lacunes en matière de prestation et élaboration et mise en oeuvre de mesures correctives appropriées.

• Maintenir le contrôle de la qualité des échanges de cas, de l'actualité, de l'exhaustivité et des activités de rapprochement, en veillant à ce que les écarts soient étudiés et résolus de façon appropriée.

• Collaborer avec l'équipe VM de PV et, le cas échéant, avec l'équipe VM de Sobi PV eESP, pour comprendre les préoccupations sur le rendement et la qualité, et élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des mesures correctives appropriées.
Études cliniques, produits commercialisés et gestion des données de sécurité

• Travailler avec le chef de file ODT Tech et l'équipe OSIRIS Config pour assurer la configuration appropriée des produits, des essais cliniques et des autorisations de mise sur le marché.

• Diriger l'élaboration et la reddition de comptes globale pour le niveau d'études.

• Comptable pour la formation d'étude du fournisseur de traitement de cas

• Superviser la collaboration avec les opérations cliniques, les affaires réglementaires mondiales, les organismes de recherche contractuels, la gestion des données cliniques et d'autres parties prenantes afin d'assurer le transfert, le rapprochement et la déclaration appropriés des données sur l'innocuité.

• Responsable de la préparation, de l'approbation et du maintien du niveau de produit de traitement de cas Guides d'information sur la sécurité des produits et évaluation appropriée du matériel du Programme de recherches sur le marché et de soutien aux patients pour l'impact du VP.
Qualité, conformité, audits et inspections

• Travaillez en étroite collaboration avec GPV Excellence, Sobi QA, PV VM, d'autres fonctions Sobi et fournisseurs externes pour nous assurer de la qualité et des normes de conformité et défini et maintenu pour les activités PV avec les partenaires.

• Assurer la qualité et la conformité des activités de partenariat et d'exploitation du VP, y compris l'identification proactive et la gestion des risques opérationnels, de qualité et de conformité.

• Travailler avec les responsables des sciences de la sécurité pour s'assurer que les données sur la sécurité des cas individuels sont de qualité appropriée pour appuyer les activités de déclaration globale et de gestion des signaux et assurer la rétroaction, avec les mesures correctives appropriées, du fournisseur de traitement des cas

• Agir en tant qu'expert principal en matière de vérification et d'inspections liées aux activités de partenariat et d'exploitation PV

• Superviser les enquêtes sur la non-conformité, les mesures correctives et préventives, l'escalade des problèmes, l'état de préparation aux inspections et la préparation, la coordination et le suivi des vérifications pertinentes et des inspections réglementaires.
Systèmes photovoltaïques, bases de données et collaboration interfonctionnelle

• Responsable de s'assurer que les partenariats, les activités d'étude ou les produits nouveaux et/ou modifiés qui ont une incidence sur le système PV de Sobi et les activités du fournisseur PV de Sobi sont bien identifiés et traités par les équipes responsables (y compris l'équipe de configuration de Sobi PV, Osiris). En plus des fonctions responsables, veiller à ce que les systèmes soient mis en place et fonctionnent de manière appropriée pour respecter les engagements de Sobi GPV PV.

• Leadership de l'équipe PV Partnership contribution à l'acquisition d'entreprises, l'intégration de produits et d'autres activités de développement d'entreprise avec impact sur le système PV Sobi. Y compris la contribution au futur modèle d'exploitation PV, l'alignement clair des rôles et des responsabilités entre Sobi PV et un partenaire, la conception et la livraison d'une migration de données PV et l'intégration des produits et activités dans le système PV Sobi. la configuration du système PV et la disponibilité opérationnelle des produits,

• Surveillance du gestionnaire de partenariat PV respectif dans la conception, la mise en place, les opérations et la fermeture du système PV pour soutenir les études cliniques parrainées par Sobi et les SSI

• Responsable de la boîte de réception sur l'innocuité des médicaments et pour assurer la surveillance et la couverture continue de l'équipe.

• Servir d'interface fonctionnelle principale entre les opérations PV, les sciences de la sécurité et les fonctions opérationnelles pertinentes de Sobi sur des questions propres à un produit ou à un processus (p. ex., les questions de traitement de cas).

Éducation/expérience d'apprentissage/expérience de travail
Requis :

• Diplôme universitaire en biosciences, soins de santé ou pharmacie.

• Au moins 10 ans d'expérience pertinente en pharmacovigilance au sein de l'industrie pharmaceutique, y compris une solide expérience dans le traitement des cas, la gestion des données sur l'innocuité des études cliniques, la surveillance des partenaires/vendors et les exigences réglementaires applicables en matière de VPG, de PCG et de réglementation mondiale.

• Expérience de la direction et du développement d'équipes, y compris la gestion efficace des personnes, la supervision, le renforcement des capacités et la hiérarchisation des tâches dans un environnement opérationnel complexe.

• Forte capacité d'organisation, de planification, de hiérarchisation et de résolution de problèmes.
Désiré :

• Connaissance pratique de la plateforme IQVIA Vigilance.

• Précédente expérience internationale / mondiale de gestion des personnes.
Compétences/Connaissance/Langues

• Connaissance approfondie du GVP et du GCP.

• Anglais, écrit et parlé.
Attributs personnels

• Capacité de travailler efficacement pour atteindre des objectifs ambitieux.

• Leadership efficace de l'équipe, perfectionnement et gestion de l'équipe. Capacité de préparer, d'habiliter et de soutenir l'équipe chargée de couvrir la vaste gamme de produits livrables dont elle est responsable.

• Capacité de travailler en collaboration dans des cadres et des équipes de matrice internes et externes.

• Résoudre les problèmes de façon proactive, indépendante et collaborative avec le jugement, la détermination et le courage de résoudre ou d'intensifier les problèmes, selon le cas. Capacité d'orienter l'évaluation collaborative et le développement de solutions et la mise en œuvre efficace à des problèmes complexes et interfonctionnels et interentreprises

• Constructeur de relations solides et collaborateur au sein de PV et dans toute l'organisation.

• Communicateur clair, capable de distiller de grandes quantités d'informations à la racine et de proposer des actions appropriées.

• Jugement sain et équilibré; capable d'évaluer et de gérer les risques; confiance en soi, proactif et décisif.

Rémunération et rémunérations totales à Sobi
Chez Sobi, nous nous engageons à offrir à nos employés un ensemble complet et concurrentiel de récompenses. Notre philosophie de rémunération est conçue pour reconnaître et récompenser les talents, en veillant à ce que vos contributions soient valorisées et reflétées dans vos récompenses globales.
Tous les employés de Sobi doivent démontrer des comportements conformes aux valeurs fondamentales de Sobi : soins, ambition, urgence, propriété et partenariat. Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie de l'équipe Sobi ? Venez rejoindre une culture qui permet à chaque personne d'être la personne qui fait une différence pour les maladies rares.
Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Nous sommes une entreprise mondiale avec plus de 1 900 employés dans plus de 30 pays et sommes engagés dans les sociétés où nous opérons. Avec une équipe de gestion profondément qualifiée dirigeant nos victoires quotidiennes, et un conseil d'administration avec un bilan remarquable, nous sommes prêts à prendre sur le monde des maladies, des maladies et de l'adversité. Notre peuple croit qu'il a le pouvoir d'avoir un impact positif sur les autres, parce que c'est exactement ce que nous faisons ici. Si vous cherchez une carrière qui tire profit de vos talents d'une manière qui fait du monde un endroit meilleur et plus sain, nous pouvons juste avoir un emploi pour vous.

Nous savons que nos employés sont notre atout le plus précieux, et notre culture le démontre. Nous offrons un ensemble d'avantages concurrentiels, pour soutenir la santé et le bonheur de notre personnel.

Culture sobi

À Sobi, nous refusons le statu quo. C'est parce que nous avons été témoins de première main des défis auxquels sont confrontés les personnes touchées par des maladies rares et que nous avons utilisé ces connaissances pour façonner notre entreprise afin de trouver de nouvelles façons de les aider.

En tant qu'entreprise biopharmaceutique spécialisée, nous sommes dédiés aux maladies rares. Et nous voyons cette concentration comme une force. En transformant efficacement nos recherches en traitements révolutionnaires, nous aidons à rendre la médecine plus accessible et à ouvrir davantage de possibilités aux patients et à ceux qui les prennent en charge. Cela a été notre approche depuis le premier jour, mais nous savons que nous ne pouvons pas changer le monde des maladies rares par nous-mêmes. Pour y parvenir, il faut établir des partenariats solides avec les patients, les partenaires et les intervenants dans toute la chaîne de valeur. Ensemble, nous définissons comment notre entreprise peut créer des solutions qui répondent aux besoins des personnes touchées par des maladies rares tout en facilitant une croissance durable.

jobs.title: Global Product Safety Science Lead
jobs.description:
Product-level safety ownership

• Perform and lead signal detection, evaluation, validation and escalation activities for assigned product(s).

• Set the strategy for safety signal detection methodology, signal tracking and oversight of safety signals for assigned products.

• Drive, perform and document benefit‑risk evaluations and ensure appropriate risk‑management strategies are implemented.

• Lead and perform assessments for the preparation, review and approval of key safety deliverables (e.g. PSURs, DSURs, RMPs, regulatory responses).

• Translate safety data insights into actionable recommendations for product‑level benefit–risk discussions and regulatory interactions.

• Lead the clinical safety science interactions with partner companies for the assigned products (if applicable) ensuring sharing of safety information per the SDEA and the set up and collaborative functioning of the JSMT.

• Provide safety scientific input to ISS Evaluation Committee as required.

• In case of product quality escalations, work cross functionally to understand impacts on patients, and (if required) lead the preparation of a medical impact Health Hazard Assessment statement.

Cross-functional execution (MDT)

• Act as the Safety Science representative in the Medical Development Team (MDT) and ensure integration of safety into product development and lifecycle decisions.

• Provide clinical safety input into study design, conduct, analysis and interpretation, including study‑level Safety Lead responsibilities where applicable.

• Provide medical and pharmacovigilance expertise e.g. for the clinical safety strategy of the product clinical development program, the development of the Target Product Profile (TPP), the development and maintenance of the RSI, including IB and CDS

Governance and decision-making

• Chair product‑level Benefit Risk Teams (BRTs) and ensure effective operation per SOPs.

• Represent the BRT at Benefit Risk Council (BRC).

• Serve as the primary decision-maker for product-level safety issues, including signal validation and escalation.

Collaboration and delivery

• Lead interactions with external partners and service providers related to assigned product safety deliverables.

• Support regulatory interactions, inspections and audits at product level.

People and capability development

• Mentor colleagues and support capability development within the product safety team.

Continuous improvement & data-driven decision making

• Actively use and continuously develop proficiency in safety systems, data visualization tools, and AI‑enabled analyses (e.g. Veeva Vault(s), analytics dashboards) to support robust and efficient signal detection, safety assessments, and decision‑making for assigned products.

• Identify opportunities for process, data and system improvements within Safety Science.

Level of autonomy: works independently with accountability for assigned products, escalating complex or cross‑product issues as appropriate.

Education/Learning Experience/Work Experience
 Required:

• MD, PharmD, PhD or Master’s in Life Sciences/Public Health

• Solid experience in pharmacovigilance and safety science within a pharmaceutical or regulatory environment

• Strong knowledge of global PV regulations (e.g., GVP, ICH E2E), pharmacovigilance processes and practices

• Proficiency to analyse, synthesize medical & scientific safety data and contribute to scientific interpretation

• Strong communication & stakeholder collaboration skills

• Proficiency in Excel, database querying (e.g., SQL), and basic data visualization (e.g., Power BI, Spotfire), AI-related tools

• Experience working with development programs and with products with market approvals

• Experience leading cross functional global product safety management teams, successfully delivering medical safety strategy, with experience across safety signal process, aggregate report writing, safety risk communication and safety risk management

Desired:

• Experience working with partner companies to successfully develop and market products across global markets

• Experience presenting medical safety information at Health Authority meetings

• Demonstrated expertise in the understanding, interpretation, and application of various country/regional pharmacovigilance requirements

Skills/Knowledge/Languages
 Required:

• High quality written and spoken English

• Strong analytical skills

• Effective communicator (oral, writing, presentations) at all levels of the business

• Ability to work effectively to fulfil ambitious goals

• Sound and balanced judgment skills; able to assess and handle risks; self-confident, proactive and decisive

• Demonstrated ability to lead safety activities and scientific discussions

• Strong team-leadership capabilities. Demonstrated relationship builder both internally and externally; a strong collaborator within PV function, leadership and the wider organisation
